remarks: Experience the best of SoNo living in this beautifully updated bright and sunny studio located in the sought-after Washington Street district. Nestled among historic cobblestone streets, this residence offers the perfect blend of character, convenience, and modern comfort. This unit features high ceilings, a private deck, renovated kitchen & bathroom, dishwasher, washer/dryer in unit, central air and freshly painted. Offered as a turnkey opportunity, perfect for a seamless move-in or investment setup. Step outside and immerse yourself in one of Fairfield County's most vibrant neighborhoods. Enjoy immediate access to SoNo's acclaimed restaurants, cafes, boutique shopping, nightlife, and waterfront attractions. Commuters will appreciate the close proximity to the South Norwalk Metro-North station, offering convenient access to New York City and New Haven, along with easy connections to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and Route 7. ***TRANSFERABLE COVERED PARKING SPOT IN LOWER LEVEL OF THE HAVILAND LOT***
